title: first-wave-capacity-sentinel-and-operator-cue
body:
Purpose: lightweight, ops-friendly runbook + rolling KPI ledger for the 'first-wave' customer cohort (internal beta → early GA). This doc is meant to be the single-pane cue for on-call operators and product ops shift leads during ramp windows.

Scope: covers capacity prescience (GPU pools + burst), staffing cue cards, 0→20k requests/day gating metrics, and three graded contingency actions if signals degrade. Not the final SLA doc; links to full SLO spec in linked artifacts.

Quick read (top lines):
- Primary owner: Aisha Patel (product-ops) — accountable for cadence and handoff.
- Oncall lead (week A): Marco Ruiz; backup: Claire Nguyen.
- Launch window: 2026-03-01 → 2026-03-14 (first-wave ramp).
- Traffic gating: slow-roll 1% → 5% → 25% every 6h dependent on KPIs.

Checklist (pre-window):
- Confirm Dedicated pool sizing + burst policy (infra ticked)
- Verify model variants pinned for fallback (serving-runtime PR #789)
- Capacity runbook uploaded to SRE drive and verified with smoke tests
- Alert thresholds and dashboards validated in Grafana (links above)

KPI snapshot (rolling watchlist, updated hourly):
Timestamp, QPS, p50 lat (ms), p95 lat (ms), error rate %, avg tokens, cost/token
2026-02-14 08:00, 2.1, 45, 190, 0.12, 12.4, $0.0012
2026-02-14 09:00, 3.8, 48, 205, 0.17, 13.0, $0.0013
(operators: paste hourly export here)

Staffing rota (first 72h):
- Day 0 (launch): Operator A (Marco) 08:00-20:00, Operator B (Claire) 12:00-24:00, Escalation: Samir 24:00-08:00
- Day 1–3: staggered overlaps to maintain triage handoff at 08:00 and 20:00

Signal definitions + triggers (graded):
- Green: p95 < 250ms, error rate < 0.25% — continue slow-roll cadence.
- Yellow (operator attention): p95 250–400ms OR error rate 0.25%–0.75% OR sustained QPS variance > 20% vs projection — increase monitoring frequency to 15m; pause next traffic step until cleared.
- Red (action required): p95 > 400ms OR error rate > 0.75% OR internal latency injection failures — initiate Contingency-1 immediately.

Contingency actions (fast paths):
- Contingency-1 (soft fallback): divert 30% of requests to smaller model variant with tuned quantization, enable prefix caching aggressively; notify infra and product. (Owner: Samir)
- Contingency-2 (capacity rebalance): add burst pool nodes from reserved capacity, throttle non-critical batch jobs, widen autoscale policy temporarily; open incident with SRE. (Owner: Elena)
- Contingency-3 (roll-back/traffic cut): abort rollout, revert traffic to pre-launch route, issue customer comms template. Exec notify required.

Incident notes template (operators copy/paste):
- Time, trigger, current KPIs, immediate action taken, contact points (SRE, model-owner, product-ops), links to logs and traces.

Open questions / TODOs: 
- Confirm runbook for prefix cache invalidation when model rollouts change KV shape (action: infra to document by 2026-02-21).
- Decide if first-wave includes embeddings-heavy customers (affects capacity calc). Product to confirm by 2026-02-18.

Immediate next actions (this doc):
1) Validate the Grafana board with synthetic traffic (Marco) — due 2025-11-07.
2) Upload final staffing calendar to shared rota (Aisha) — due 2025-11-10.
3) Finalize customer cohort list and expected QPS buckets (Product lead) — due 2025-11-12.

Notes to self (working):
- Keep this doc lightweight — operators need clear triggers + exactly one primary action per trigger.
- Avoid long procedural prose; link to longer runbooks for deep-dive.

Revision history:
- 2025-11-03 created (initial capacity and cue draft)
- 2025-12-16 updated (added contingency-2 steps after capacity war game)
- 2026-02-14 editorial update (clarified p95 thresholds and staffing overlaps)

Appendix: canned customer communication snippets, short checklist for post-mortem capture, and quick links to dashboards and SLOs (use linked_artifacts above).
kpi_notes: Operators: when you paste hourly exports, preserve timestamp and QPS columns. Use the error rate to decide yellow vs red. If cost/token spikes > 25% without latency improvement, flag for product-ops review.
doc_summary: Single-pane operator playbook for early ramp: capacity checks, hourly KPI ledger, staffing rota, and three-tier contingency actions. Designed for quick decisions during first-wave traffic increases.
